description:
## Objective

Port the Flow component and execution-seam authoring scenarios.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-04-1255-test-flow-authoring-suite-plan.md`
Unit: `U2`
Covers: `R5`, `R7-R9`, `R11-R14`, `KTD1-KTD6`

This task restores end-to-end authoring proof for public Flow components without duplicating the focused unit suites.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `jido-nnq.1` for shared fixtures, Catalog data, and the source ledger.
- Unblocks: `jido-nnq.4` by supplying the component and dependency-seam evidence.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: `main` after `jido-nnq.1` lands.
- Combine: Remain independent from U3. U4 combines the landed U2 and U3 outputs.

## Source inventory

- Three source tests: `components_test.exs`, `flow_edges_test.exs`, and `schema_pipeline_test.exs` — ported and adapted.
- Shared support assets from U1 — reused and changed only when the current component contract requires it.
- Current-only Parallel and Handoff forms — add one bounded valid and invalid authoring case each.

## API and behavior map

- Old Map, Reduce, Iterate, Subflow, Choice, and Invoke records -> current canonical component records. Evidence: `test/jido/flow/canonical_authoring_test.exs`.
- Old local reference scopes -> current `Jido.Flow.Ref` scopes. Evidence: `test/jido/flow/component_validation_test.exs`.
- Old runtime error structs -> current structured execution errors. Evidence: `test/jido/exec/node/**`.
- Missing old Parallel coverage -> current public Parallel authoring contract. Evidence: `test/jido/flow/parallel_test.exs`.

## Files

- Read: fixed source component tests, `test/jido/flow/canonical_authoring_test.exs`, `test/jido/flow/parallel_test.exs`, `test/jido/flow/component_validation_test.exs`, `test/jido/exec/node/**`
- Change: shared files under `test/authoring/support/flows/**` only when required
- Add: `test/authoring/flows/components_test.exs`, `test/authoring/flows/flow_edges_test.exs`, `test/authoring/flows/schema_pipeline_test.exs`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `refs/**`, U3 source-diagnostic files, general execution tests
- Expected shared changes: bounded shared fixture updates only

## Instructions

1. Adapt the component matrix to current canonical records and current errors.
2. Preserve fail-fast, collect-errors, ordering, context, schema, dependency, and continuation behavior.
3. Add one bounded valid and invalid Parallel and Handoff authoring case.
4. Keep all new modules in the authoring lane and serialize message-order cases.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Map, Reduce, Iterate, Subflow, Choice, and Invoke retain supported cross-form and execution behavior.
- [ ] Invalid local scopes, conditions, state, output, and continuations fail before unintended work.
- [ ] Parallel and Handoff each have one current valid and invalid authoring case.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test.authoring test/authoring/flows/components_test.exs test/authoring/flows/flow_edges_test.exs test/authoring/flows/schema_pipeline_test.exs --warnings-as-errors` — exits with status 0.
- `mix format --check-formatted` and `git diff --check` — exit with status 0.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source disposition records, verification results, deviations from the plan, deferred assets, linked follow-up tickets, and remaining blockers.
A product failure must include the exact command, expected result, actual result, and a separate follow-up ticket before this task can close.
title: Port Flow component authoring seams
